title: General SRS for Positioning can be configured to be transmitted in RRC_INACTIVE mode.

entities.name: SRS for Positioning Configuration in RRC_INACTIVE Mode
entities.description: Procedure for configuring Sounding Reference Signal (SRS) for positioning to be transmitted while UE is in RRC_INACTIVE state.

entities.name: RRCRelease(SuspendConfig)
entities.description: RRC Release message containing SuspendConfig configuration that enables SRS for positioning transmission in RRC_INACTIVE mode.

entities.name: RRC_INACTIVE
entities.description: RRC state where UE can be configured to transmit SRS for positioning signals.

entities.name: SuspendConfig
entities.description: Configuration information element that includes parameters for SRS positioning transmission in inactive state.

entities.name: SRS for Positioning Transmission
entities.description: Capability for UE to transmit Sounding Reference Signals specifically for positioning purposes.

relations.description: The procedure includes transmission of RRCRelease message with SuspendConfig
RRCRelease message contains SuspendConfig information element
The procedure requires UE to be in RRC_INACTIVE state
SuspendConfig IE enables SRS for positioning transmission capability
